new_today_news.headline: Darling Ingredients at Barclays Conference: Margins, Debt and Peptides
new_today_news.summary: Darling Ingredients management discussed renewable diesel margins, feedstock constraints, and regional market dislocations. North American fat markets remain tight, with animal fat prices expected to stay elevated through 2026-2027.

new_today_news.headline: Darling Ingredients Enters a New Strategic Growth Phase
new_today_news.summary: Analysis of Darling Ingredients' structural advantages in collecting and processing fats for renewable diesel through its Valero joint venture. Highlights renewable diesel and circular economy as strategic tailwinds for the company.

recent_news.headline: Used Cooking Oil Recycling for Sustainability & ESG Reporting
recent_news.summary: Article discusses how commercial kitchens can leverage UCO recycling partnerships to improve ESG reporting, obtain LEED certification, and enhance environmental credentials. Highlights the role of certified oil collection providers in transforming UCO into renewable diesel and biodiesel.

recent_news.headline: Wind River Environmental Acquires GDM Environmental, Marking First Western U.S. Expansion
recent_news.summary: Wind River Environmental acquired Colorado-based GDM Environmental, a grease trap and septic services specialist. This marks the company's first expansion into the western United States and brings total acquisitions past 100.
